8D Audio Panner

The viral 8D audio effect: your track circles around your head with a rotating stereo-pan LFO. Play it and download it.

🎧 Headphones required for the full effect.
One full orbit every 6.7 seconds.

A rotating stereo-pan LFO orbits the sound around you. Preview and download use the same graph — rendered in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an audio file (headphones on!).
  2. Set the rotation speed.
  3. Click "Play 8D" to hear it orbit.
  4. Click "Download 8D WAV" to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is 8D audio?

An LFO (low-frequency oscillator) continuously sweeps the stereo pan position in a circle, so the sound appears to orbit around you — best with headphones.

Do I need headphones?

Yes — use headphones or earphones; the effect is a stereo illusion.

Is my audio uploaded?

Yes — both the live preview and the download use the same rotating-pan graph, rendered in your browser.
